end.summary:
Practised drawing dot pictures for square and triangular numbers.
Used added dots on each side to show a triangular sequence growing from 6 to 9 dots.
Explored row-and-column counting for square arrays, including the repeated corner dot.
The 5-by-5 square was later identified as 25 dots; teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised showing number sequences with dot pictures. They explained that adding one dot to each side of a 6-dot triangle makes 9 dots, and later used 5 × 5 to identify 25 dots. There was a mix-up when counting rows and columns and subtracting the repeated corner, but the 5-by-5 result was corrected later in the lesson. At home, draw a few 3-by-3, 4-by-4, and triangular dot pictures and ask Ishita to explain how each grows.
